She is seated gracefully on the floor, leaning slightly against a wall beside a modern elevator. Both legs are bent in an elegant relaxed posture. A beige handbag, smartphone, glasses, and an open laptop sit nearby; the laptop displays only an abstract unreadable downward-trending chart interface with no text or logos.
